description: Replace the random generator panel in ui_detail.c with a Sim Control Panel that exposes the sim_task parameters for the active profile (random_walk, sine, ramp). The panel is hidden for SIM_STEADY metrics. The random generator (Gen Once, Start Auto, interval buttons) is removed entirely — sim_task is the sole driver of automatic value generation.

userStories.title: Remove random generator section from ui_detail.c
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to delete the random generator panel from ui_detail.c since sim_task already handles automatic value generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Static variables removed: s_rand_start_btn, s_rand_start_lbl, s_interval_btns[5], s_rand_timer, s_rand_interval_idx, s_intervals[], s_interval_labels[]
Functions removed: rand_gen_once(), rand_timer_cb(), rand_once_btn_cb(), rand_start_btn_cb(), interval_btn_cb(), update_interval_btns()
The rand_sect card and its children are removed from ui_detail_create()
open_context() has the s_rand_timer cleanup block removed
Direct riscv32-esp-elf-gcc compile of main/ui/ui_detail.c produces zero errors and zero new warnings
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add s_sim_panel card skeleton and show/hide logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the sim panel card created in ui_detail_create() and shown/hidden by open_context() based on the metric's sim_profile.
acceptanceCriteria: Static variable s_sim_panel (lv_obj_t*) added to ui_detail.c
s_sim_panel card created in ui_detail_create() in place of rand_sect, full-width, same card styling as other cards in the screen
open_context() calls a static helper sim_panel_configure(m) that adds LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN when m->sim_profile == SIM_STEADY and clears it otherwise
rand_h constant replaced with sim_panel_h = 56 (header row only for now); viz_h formula updated to use sim_panel_h
viz_h remains >= 80 px after the height change
Direct riscv32-esp-elf-gcc compile of main/ui/ui_detail.c produces zero errors and zero new warnings

userStories.title: Add rand_min / rand_max parameter rows for SIM_RANDOM_WALK
userStories.description: As a demo operator, I want to tune the min/max range of a random-walk metric on the fly without editing JSON.
acceptanceCriteria: Two +/- rows inside s_sim_panel: 'Min' row for rand_min, 'Max' row for rand_max; each has a key label, a value label (s_sim_rw_min_lbl / s_sim_rw_max_lbl), and − / + buttons
sim_panel_configure() shows these rows only when m->sim_profile == SIM_RANDOM_WALK; hides them otherwise
sim_panel_configure() populates value labels with current m->rand_min and m->rand_max
Tapping − / + updates m->rand_min or m->rand_max on the live Metric struct (via s_ctx_tank / s_ctx_machine / s_ctx_metric) by ±m->step
Clamp rand_min to [m->min_val, m->rand_max - m->step]; clamp rand_max to [m->rand_min + m->step, m->max_val]
sim_panel_h updated so viz_h remains >= 80 px with these rows visible
Direct riscv32-esp-elf-gcc compile of main/ui/ui_detail.c produces zero errors
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add amplitude / period / offset parameter rows for SIM_SINE
userStories.description: As a demo operator, I want to adjust the sine wave shape of a sine-profile metric on the fly.
acceptanceCriteria: Three +/- rows inside s_sim_panel: 'Ampl' (amplitude), 'Period' (period_s), 'Offset'; each has a key label, value label, and − / + buttons
sim_panel_configure() shows these rows only when m->sim_profile == SIM_SINE; hides them otherwise
sim_panel_configure() populates labels with current m->sim_amplitude, m->sim_period_s, m->sim_offset
Tapping − / + updates the corresponding field on the live Metric struct: amplitude step = m->step; period step = 1.0f; offset step = m->step
Clamp: amplitude >= 0; period >= 1.0f; offset clamped so offset - amplitude >= m->min_val and offset + amplitude <= m->max_val
Direct riscv32-esp-elf-gcc compile of main/ui/ui_detail.c produces zero errors
Typecheck passes
